rca of the issue: Root cause was in /app/frontend/src/pages/ops/ProjectRequests.jsx runStockCheck() which POSTed the whole form (including monthly_rate:'', months:'', amount:'') to /api/project-requests/stock-check. The Pydantic RequestIn model expects Optional[float] and does NOT coerce empty string to None in v2, returning HTTP 422 float_parsing. FIX: runStockCheck now sends only {request_type, items:[{...,quantity:Number,rate:Number}]} — no numeric fields at all — which satisfies the schema. Two additional backend guards were added: raise_pr requires status=='with_dept' (previously accepted 'pending_approval'), and close_request now checks status in ('fulfilled','with_dept','pr_raised').
